idea-plugin.name: ViewMD
idea-plugin.description:
ViewMD delivers a cleaner, smarter Markdown preview for Android Studio and IntelliJ-based IDEs.

Tired of squeezed tables wrapping text one letter per line or missing offline diagram renderers? ViewMD fixes markdown rendering friction with responsive layouts and offline-first tools.

Key Features

  • Responsive Table Scrolling: Wide tables scroll horizontally inside an overflow container with sticky headers, zebra striping, and readable column widths — no more squeezed columns.
  • Table Action Toolbar: Hover over any table to quickly copy it as clean GitHub Flavored Markdown or TSV for Google Sheets/Excel.
  • YAML Front Matter Cards: Document metadata headers (summary:, triggers:, index:) render as sleek, collapsible information cards.
  • 100% Offline Diagrams: Bundled client-side Mermaid diagrams and in-process PlantUML (powered by Smetana) — zero remote calls or CDN dependencies.
  • Custom CSS Diagnostics: Robust path resolver for custom stylesheets (supporting ~, relative paths, and absolute paths) with live reload.
  • Dynamic Theme Switching: Seamlessly adapts to light, dark, and high-contrast IDE themes.
  • Export & Sharing: One-click "Open in Browser" and "Export as HTML" with bundled inlined styles.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release of ViewMD for Android Studio and IntelliJ IDEA.
  • Horizontal table scroll container preventing text column squeezing.
  • Interactive table toolbar with Copy Markdown and Copy TSV options.
  • Collapsible YAML front matter card display with chip styling.
  • Offline Mermaid and PlantUML rendering without external dependencies.
  • Live custom CSS reload and path validation diagnostics.
  • Standalone HTML export and browser preview actions.
